title: How to Park on a Steep Hill Properly
hook: Never leave your wheels straight when parking uphill.

script.narration: Never leave your wheels straight when parking uphill.
script.visual_search: car parked on a steep hill angle view

script.narration: First, pull close to the curb and stop completely with your foot on the brake.
script.visual_search: driver stepping on car brake pedal

script.narration: Second, turn your steering wheel sharply away from the curb so the tires face the street.
script.visual_search: steering wheel turning quickly close up

script.narration: Third, let the car roll back gently until the front tire rests firmly against the curb.
script.visual_search: car tire touching curb close up

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you always use your parking brake on hills? Comment yes or no.

description:
Learn the proper way to park your car on a steep hill to prevent rollaways. This quick step-by-step guide is essential for all new drivers in the USA.

Master safe parking habits in under 60 seconds with our daily driving tips.
